scope: Source-call census and explicit supported parameter domains; not a graphics or runtime qualification receipt.

policy.BoxMesh: Continuous finite-positive Vector3 dimensions: portable C# packed-unit-box generator, checked against every Mac reference. Template entries are regression references, not a runtime size whitelist.
policy.SphereMesh: Eight fixed literal configurations: shared art/menu sphere, snow, scenery beads/starfield, explosion and burnout caches.
policy.CylinderMesh: Finite source-constant/loop domain: literal effect and menu cylinders, fixed stage dimensions for miniatures, and bounded scenery taper/cone parameters. Every exact supported request is listed below; runtime refuses others.
policy.PlaneMesh: Fixed world/particle planes plus seven-stage menu footprint variants; all exact parameter sets listed below.
policy.TorusMesh: Fixed exit, throw, tutorial, meteor and Greedy rings; three orbital iterations, three cabinet rails and two result arches; all exact parameter sets listed below.
policy.owned-generator-or-helper: Own C# SurfaceTool/ArrayMesh generators and their helper calls, including continuous dimensions; no native PrimitiveMesh regeneration.
policy.canonical-bomber-library: Existing 32-mesh Mac-authored library; editable generators remain authoring sources and exported consumers load pinned bytes.
policy.template-storage-and-portable-box: Hash-checked resource storage, guarded Mac authoring, or portable box generation; not a procedural engine fallback.
policy.test-only: Explicit harness meshes; not product geometry.
